projects.name: Pseudocode Runner
projects.subject: coding
projects.description: Run Cambridge 9618 pseudocode in the browser and step through it line by line.

page.tagline: Write Cambridge 9618 pseudocode and watch it run, one line at a time.
page.intro: Pseudocode Runner checks your syntax as you type and runs your program **step by step**, showing every variable as it changes. It follows the [Cambridge 9618 pseudocode guide](https://example.com/9618-guide), so what you practise is what the exam expects.

reasons.title: Made for the exam
reasons.text: Only the keywords and rules of the 9618 guide: no surprises on Paper 2 or Paper 4.

reasons.title: See what your code does
reasons.text: Step through a program and watch each variable, array and file change.

reasons.title: Free, no account
reasons.text: Download it and start. Nothing to sign up for, no ads.

features.title: Run and step
features.text: Run the whole program, or one line at a time.

features.title: Clear errors
features.text: Mistakes are explained in plain words, with the line they are on.

features.title: Arrays and records
features.text: 1D and 2D arrays, records and enumerated types, shown as tables.

features.title: Text files
features.text: OPENFILE, READFILE and WRITEFILE work on real files.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Choose your computer below and download the installer.

steps.title: Open an example
steps.text: File → Examples has a program for every topic.

steps.title: Step through it
steps.text: Press Step and watch the variables panel.

faq.question: Does it work without the internet?
faq.answer: Yes. Once installed, it never needs a connection.

faq.question: Can I use it for Paper 4?
faq.answer: Paper 4 is done in Python, Java or VB. Use the Runner to plan your algorithm in pseudocode first.
